evaluation.affected_run: at least one duplicate mutation, conflicting action, provider rejection, or unresolved ambiguous outcome
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: workflow-checkpoint appears in the observed sidecar tool set
evaluation.efficiency_estimator: median paired percent change for overlapping-worker trials

execution_constraint: The single production backend cannot serve the exact v1.6.0 and v1.7.0 fail-closed local planners simultaneously. Run no-sidecar and v1.6.0 before the production upgrade, then v1.7.0 after it. This prevents fully randomized cross-version execution order and blocks confirmatory claims.
publication_policy: Publish safety, efficiency, neutral, negative, invalid, and infrastructure results. Do not pool these rows with the prior 200-run publication.
